title: Nested VP1 PCR and Nanopore Sequencing from Stool and ES Samples
author: Alex Shaw
materials: Amplify using the following cycling conditions:
Ligation of Barcode Adapter Add the reagents in the order given below: 15 µL End prep DNA 10 µL Barcode Adapter 25 µL Blunt/TA Ligase Master Mix

End-prep and dA-tailing: Add the following reagents in a 0.2 mL PCR tube. 47 µL 1 µg DNA 3.5 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Buffer 2 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Mix 3.5 µL Ultra II End-prep reaction buffer 3 µL Ultra II End-prep enzyme mix

Adaptor ligation: Thaw and prepare the kit reagents as follows: Spin down and thaw Adapter Mix (AMX-F) on ice Spin down T4 Ligase from NEBNext Quick Ligation Module (E6056) on ice Thaw Ligation Buffer (LNB) at room temperature, spin down, mix by pipetting. Place on ice. Thaw Elution Buffer (EB) at room temperature, mix by vortexing, spin down. Place on ice. Thaw one tube of S Fragment Buffer (SFB)* for VP1 at room temperature, mix by vortexing, spin down and place on ice. *For panEV sequencing, use L Fragment Buffer (LFB)
Use the Oxford Nanopore Ltd MinKNOW software to begin a sequencing run. Note that the piranha software package (step 53) will accept data that has been demultiplexed in MinKNOW.
End-prep & dA-tailing: Prepare the following reaction mix:

steps.title: Prepare First Round Nested PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare a Master mix for the first round of nested PCR (panEV primers), excluding the forward primer and RNA.

substeps.instruction: Use Forward Primer (5'NTR): [TGGCGGAACCGACTACTTTGGGTG]
Use Reverse Primer (Cre): [TCAATACGGTGTTTGCTCTTGAACTG]
For nOPV2 detection, mix Reverse primer Cre with nOPV2-R [TCGATACGGTGCTTGGATTTAAATTG] in equal quantities to create a 10 µM working solution
Briefly vortex and centrifuge the master mix
Add 19 µL of master mix and 5 µL of eluted RNA to each PCR tube
Incubate at 50 °C for 30 minutes
Add 1 µL of the forward primer to the tubes

steps.title: Perform Second Round VP1 Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify VP1 using Q8/Y7 primers. If using barcoded primers, follow the specific volume adjustments.

substeps.instruction: Prepare primers: Forward Primer (Y7) GGGTTTGTGTCAGCCTGTAATGA and Reverse Primer (Q8) AAGAGGTCTCTRTTCCACAT (or barcoded versions from Shaw et al 2020).
Premix primers in a 96 well plate (10 µM forward and 10 µM reverse per well).
Prepare a Master mix excluding the diluted PCR product (and primers if barcoded).
Briefly vortex and centrifuge the master mix.
Aliquot 20 µL of master mix into each PCR tube (or 18 µL if using barcoded primers).
Add 2 µL of premixed forward and reverse primers if using barcoded VP1 primers.
Add 2 µL of the neat PCR product (alternatively, 5 µL of a 1:20 dilution).
Perform PCR and check a representative set of samples to confirm success.

steps.title: Purify First Round PCR Product
steps.instruction: Clean the PCR product using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Perform AMPure bead purification using 15 µL (1 : 0.6 ratio) of resuspended AMPure XP beads.
Elute in 25 µL nuclease-free water and retain 23 µL of eluate.

steps.title: Standardize and End-Prep DNA
steps.instruction: For standard primers, quantify and prepare the DNA ends.

substeps.instruction: Quantify 1 µL of purified PCR product using a Qubit fluorometer.
Transfer 1 μg of DNA into a clean PCR tube and adjust volume to 23 μL with nuclease-free water.
Mix gently by flicking and spin down.
Incubate for 5 minutes at 20 °C and 5 minutes at 65 °C.
Perform AMPure bead purification using 30 µL (1 : 1 ratio) of resuspended AMPure XP beads.
Elute in 20 µL nuclease-free water and retain 16 µL of eluate.

steps.title: Adapt DNA for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Add adapters to the end-prepped DNA.

substeps.instruction: Quantify 1 µL of end-prepped DNA using a Qubit fluorometer (target recovery > 700 ng).
Mix gently by flicking and spin down.
Incubate the reaction for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Perform AMPure bead purification using 20 µL (1 : 0.4 ratio) of resuspended AMPure XP beads.
Elute in 25 µL nuclease-free water and retain 15 µL of eluate.

steps.title: Perform Barcoding PCR
steps.instruction: Standardize adapted DNA and amplify with barcodes.

substeps.instruction: Quantify 1 µL of adapted DNA using a Qubit fluorometer.
Transfer 100 fmol of DNA into a clean PCR tube and adjust volume to 24 μL with nuclease-free water.
Set up barcoding PCR: 1 µL PCR Barcode, 24 µL 100 fmol PCR Product, and 25 µL LongAmp Taq 2x master mix.
Mix gently by flicking and spin down.
Amplify using cycling conditions: 94°C for 2 min (initial); 35 cycles of [94°C 15s, 55°C 30s, 65°C 2 min]; final extension 65°C for 10 min; hold at 10°C.
Perform AMPure bead purification using 40 µL (1 : 0.8 ratio) of resuspended AMPure XP beads.
Elute in 25 µL nuclease-free water and retain 23 µL of eluate.

steps.title: Pool Barcoded DNA
steps.instruction: Pool the barcoded amplicons based on the primer type used.

substeps.instruction: For standard VP1 primers: Quantify 1 µL of barcoded DNA via Qubit and prepare 1 µg of pooled DNA in 47 µL nuclease-free water.

For barcoded VP1 primers (Option 1 - Equimolar): Perform AMPure purification (15 µL, 1:0.6 ratio), quantify 1 µL via Qubit, calculate amounts to pool 1 µg of DNA, and adjust total volume to 47 µL with nuclease-free water.
For barcoded VP1 primers (Option 2 - Equi-volume): Pool 2 µL of every sample and proceed to the concentration step if necessary.
Optional: If pool volume > 47 µL, concentrate using AMPure beads (1:1 ratio) and elute in 50 µL nuclease-free water, retaining 47 µL.

steps.title: Ligate Adapters to Pooled DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare the final library by ligating adapters.

substeps.instruction: Mix gently by flicking and spin down.
Incubate for 5 minutes at 20 °C and 5 minutes at 65 °C.
Place on ice for 30 seconds.
Transfer sample to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Perform AMPure bead purification using 60 µL (1 : 1 ratio) of resuspended AMPure XP beads; elute in 61 µL nuclease-free water and retain 60 µL in a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Prepare ligation mix in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube: 60 µL DNA, 25 µL Ligation Buffer (LNB), 10 µL NEBNext Quick T4 DNA Ligase, and 5 µL Adapter Mix (AMX-F).
Mix gently by flicking and spin down.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a final AMPure XP cleanup to isolate the DNA library.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µL of resuspended AMPure XP beads to the ligation reaction and mix by pipetting.
Incubate on a rotator for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Pellet beads on a magnetic rack and discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice: add 250 μL LFB/SFB, resuspend by flicking, pellet, and discard supernatant.
Spin down, remove residual supernatant, and briefly air dry.
Resuspend pellet in 15 µl Elution Buffer and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Pellet beads until eluate is clear; transfer eluate to a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Store library on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Nanopore Flow Cell
steps.instruction: Thaw reagents and prime the MinION flow cell.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Sequencing Buffer (SQB), Loading Beads (LB), Flush Tether (FLT), and Flush Buffer (FLB) at room temperature, then move to ice.
Vortex and spin down SQB and FLB; spin down and pipette-mix FLT.
Open flow cell priming port cover; remove any bubbles by drawing back a few µLs.
Prepare priming mix: add 30 µL of FLT to FLB and mix by pipetting.
Load 800 µL of priming mix into the priming port; wait 5 minutes.
Load an additional 200 µL of priming mix into the priming port.

steps.title: Load Library and Sequence
steps.instruction: Load the prepared library into the flow cell and start sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly mix the Loading Beads (LB) tube by pipetting.
Prepare the library for loading in a new tube.
Mix the prepared library gently by pipetting.
Add 75 μl of sample to the flow cell via the SpotON sample port dropwise.
Replace the SpotON sample port cover, close the priming port, and replace the MinION lid.
